name: Analyze hypothetical battles between fictional characters
description: Users asked for hypothetical battle analyses and power comparisons between fictional characters from various media franchises, often providing detailed lists of abilities, power levels, or specific combat conditions to determine a winner. The requests ranged from standard head-to-head matchups to complex scenarios involving character fusions, enhanced modes, or specific tactical simulations.
